spec.title: Do referees give dark-skinned footballers more red cards? 29 teams, same data: a median of 1.31 times the odds
spec.statement: Silberzahn and colleagues (Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 2018) gave 29 research teams the same football data and the same question. The answers ran from 0.89 to 2.93 times the odds, with a median of 1.31. Twenty teams found an effect and nine didn't. This runs our own small program on the project's published table of each team's answer. It doesn't redo the 29 analyses, and a mismatch ends as inconclusive.
